# U149: A proposed goal’s type: as Tunde, a goal proposed from New goal opens its edit page with Type under “It’s proposed, so its type can still change.”; choosing “Keep a number in range” shows the limit, and with one typed Save changes keeps it proposed as a range goal; his active “Contract tests between the top 40 service pairs” has no Type on its edit page

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-PROPOSED`, `GOAL-EDIT-PAGE`
- **Budget:** at most 25 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U149

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/goals/new?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Step.** Type “Change failure rate on the new runners” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “%” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “20” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “10” into the “Target” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Next(: / $)” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Step.** Press the “Not yet: propose it” choice in the “Is it under way?” group.
- **Step.** Press the “Propose goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?…published=1”.
- Go to `/goals/{id}/edit?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** “It’s proposed, so its type can still change.” is shown (else: a proposed goal’s edit page doesn’t say its type can change).
- **Step.** Press the “Keep a number in range” button in the “Type” group.
- **Check:** “Warn this close” is shown (else: choosing a range doesn’t show the limit).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “type”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Type “12” into the “Limit” field.
- **Step.** Type “1” into the “Warn this close” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “goals/{id}”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!g && g.kind === 'range' && !!g.proposedAt && g.range?.limit === 12`, where `const id = new URL(p.url()).pathname.split('/').pop()`; `const snap = await h.snapshot()`; `const g = snap.goals.find((x) => x.id === id)`. Else it says: the proposed goal was saved as {g?.kind}, {g?.proposedAt ? 'proposed' : 'active'}, not a proposed range goal with a limit of 12.
- Go to `/goals/cfr-contract/edit?today={day}` in the demo.
- **Check:** The goal edit (`.goal-edit`) shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Type” group is not there (else: an active goal’s edit page offers Type).
